text: Record who is named as policyholder in the executed policy.
why: The immediate task identifies a contractual position. The same document may also be evidence in another inquiry.

text: Record the amount and date of a premium transfer.
why: This task reconstructs movement of value. The transfer’s legal effect requires a further inquiry.

text: Record which institution holds the original application.
why: This task identifies custody of information, not ownership of the policy.

text: Record the rights transferred by the security instrument.
why: The immediate task concerns the security interest’s content, subject to construction and governing law.

text: Record when loan proceeds were credited to the company account.
why: The immediate task reconstructs the drawdown’s movement and date.

text: Record the legal purpose for which a bank may disclose an account record.
why: The task concerns an information channel and its permitted use.

text: Record which office holds a consent power under the deed.
why: The task identifies an office and power, distinct from actual exercise.

text: Record repayment of the facility from the account.
why: The task records the payment event. Release of security must be analysed separately.

text: Record whether the lender received the amended mandate.
why: The task concerns institutional receipt and currency of information.
